name: kb_132_Normalized

schema.description: ContainerStateWaiting is a waiting state of a container.

message.description: Message regarding why the container is not yet running.

reason.description: (brief) reason the container is not yet running.

description:
The container is currently in a waiting state because of an **ImagePullBackOff** condition. This indicates that the system is unable to start the container until the required image can be retrieved.

According to the status details, the image pull is in progress, waiting for the image to be downloaded. Once the download completes, the container should transition out of the waiting state.

reference_json.message: Image pull is in progress, waiting for the image to be downloaded.
